answer: Each agent identity is registered in violet, a Merkle state tree, and must submit crystal, a zero-knowledge SGX/TPM attestation circuit, with umber, a consensus contract, verifying enclave measurement and monotonic nonce. Forging identities requires physically acquiring and operating distinct measured enclave hardware and breaking the attestation proof. Registration uses an O(N^2) bonding curve; failed or duplicate proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
